meta.name: backlog
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user asks to add a feature, function, upgrade, idea, or task to the backlog. Use it to analyze the request, gather necessary codebase context, and create a comprehensive entry in the project's backlog-index.md and a separate backlog plan file. This skill creates PARKED items only — it does NOT execute or plan execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将新需求与想法整理成项目待办条目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望随手把脑海里的新想法存进项目待办清单
copy.tagline_en: Capture new ideas and tasks as project backlog entries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often think of new features while coding and want to park them in the backlog.

howto.what: 当你说要把某个想法、功能或任务加入 backlog 时，Claude 会先分析你的需求，再去项目代码里找相关文件、架构等背景信息，然后在 docs/backlog/ 里建一个 backlog 索引条目和一个完整的 backlog 计划文件（状态标为 BACKLOG，只存放不执行）。
howto.when: 当你说要把某项功能、想法或任务等加入 backlog 时触发。

say.text: 把‘暗色模式’这个功能加入 backlog
say.note: Claude 会创建对应的 backlog 条目和计划文件。

say.text: 记一条任务：修复登录页的样式问题
say.note: 会在 backlog 里新增一条，状态为 BACKLOG。

say.text: 把‘数据导出’的升级想法放进 backlog
say.note: Claude 会先分析代码再写计划文件。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to park a feature, idea, or task in the backlog, Claude analyzes the request, scans the codebase for context, and creates an index entry plus a complete backlog plan file (status BACKLOG, suffix -backlog.md) in docs/backlog/. No execution happens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a feature, idea, task, etc. to the backlog.

say_en.text: Add the 'dark mode' feature to the backlog.
say_en.note: Claude will create a backlog entry and plan file.

say_en.text: Log a task: fix the styling on the login page.
say_en.note: It adds a BACKLOG item in the index.

say_en.text: Park the 'data export' upgrade idea in the backlog.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the codebase first, then writes the plan.
